initialExam.title: TNPSC Group 4 Services 2026
initialExam.description: TNPSC Group 4 exam for junior level posts including VAO, Junior Assistant, and Typist in Tamil Nadu government departments. Entry-level opportunity for graduates.
initialExam.eligibility: SSLC (10th) for VAO; Graduation for Junior Assistant/Typist
initialExam.qualifications: 10th pass for VAO; Graduation for other posts
initialExam.syllabus: General Studies (75Q), Tamil/English (25Q), Aptitude & Mental Ability (25Q), General Tamil/English (25Q).
initialExam.examPattern: Single paper: 150 questions, 300 marks, 3 hours. Objective type.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Exam → Certificate Verification → Counselling → Final Allotment
initialExam.jobRole: Village Administrative Officer (VAO), Junior Assistant, Typist
initialExam.careerGrowth: VAO → Deputy Tahsildar → Tahsildar. Junior Assistant → Senior Assistant → Superintendent.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit tnpsc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical, Pension

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
